primary: exact unnormalized evidence membership in the item's source or target
per_run: explanatory-prose proxy counts split by membership validity
zero_candidate_rule: All candidate-denominator rates and mean length are null; the run is uninformative, null is never coerced to zero, and any zero-candidate run makes the primary interpretation INCOMPLETE_MATRIX.
condition_aggregation: Report three runs, informative-run count, micro evidence membership, unweighted informative-run mean membership, fully-conformant informative-run count, candidate count, and informative-run rate range.
contrasts: P within S0/S2, S within P0/P1, and difference-in-differences use unweighted condition run means and are null unless all four conditions and all 12 runs are present and informative and the matrix is structurally complete.
paired_gain: Each p1-s2/p0-s0 repetition pair must contain finite non-null rates before the greater-than predicate can pass.
no_observed_difference: Requires all four conditions, exactly three registered repetitions per condition, and all 12 runs informative; equality among a partial set is insufficient.
registered_field_alias: S0 registers evidence and S2 registers evidence_quote. Exactly the registered field is structurally required; normalized RAW records evidence plus emitted and registered field names.
